Thank you for contributing to SkillForge! Please fill in this template so
reviewers can evaluate your change quickly.
-->

## What does this PR change?

Describe the change: new skill, skill update, agent, workflow, docs, or
tooling. Link any related issue.

## Official sources verified against

List the official documentation or sources you checked the content against,
with the verification date. (Not needed for typo-only fixes.)

## Checklist

- [ ] The content is original (not copied from another source).
- [ ] The skill follows `docs/SKILL-STANDARDS.md` (for skill changes).
- [ ] No invented versions, URLs, statistics, or API methods.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] The registry was regenerated with `npm run registry` (for skill
      changes) and committed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] No files under `skills/upstream/` were modified.

## Additional notes

Anything else reviewers should know.
